system.description:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, spend a Favour and hurl a spear of dark fire toward them. They must make a Reaction Roll (15), taking 2d12 magic damage on a failure and half if they succeed. You may spend a Favour to power the spell further, choose one:

  • The target is Blinded by smoke until they succeed on a Reaction Roll (10)
  • The flames burn unnaturally cold, dealing Stress instead of HP
  • The flame leaves a lingering mark; the next time the target takes damage, add +1d12
  • The flame disrupts magic; the target must mark a Stress to use magical features
